answer: Agents can require every valuable action to carry a stake locked in a trellis of prior, independently vouched interactions. A new identity starts with no reputation, so it must earn access through small jobs whose results are cross-checked by unrelated agents and whose stake is slashed when it lies or colludes. A sybil attacker therefore funds many deposits and waits through the tide of delayed trust; fake accounts cannot cheaply amplify votes, while honest history accumulates around each knoll.
